types.name: Properties of estimators
types.description: Asks which estimator is unbiased, consistent, efficient or sufficient, or for an unbiased estimate of a variance.

types.name: Confidence intervals
types.description: Asks for a confidence interval, its critical value, its width or the margin of error.

types.name: Hypotheses, errors and power
types.description: Asks about null and alternative hypotheses, Type I or Type II errors, level of significance, p-value or power.

types.name: Large-sample z tests
types.description: Gives a large sample (or known σ) and asks for the z statistic for a mean or proportion, or the decision.

types.name: t tests and their degrees of freedom
types.description: Gives a small sample with unknown σ and asks for the t statistic or its degrees of freedom.

types.name: Chi-square tests
types.description: Gives observed and expected frequencies or a contingency table and asks for χ² or its degrees of freedom.

types.name: F test for variances
types.description: Compares two sample variances and asks for the F ratio or its degrees of freedom.
